title: Equal-weight KPI soup ahead of the work object
cues: ≥4 equal KPI tiles or metric cards competing with the primary worklist — dashboard DNA on a triage decide path
ban: KPI encyclopedia must not own the decide path on triage/queue surfaces.
remediation: Collapse to ≤3 chips (kpi-collapse); park the rest in <details>; keep the work object focal; re-measure kpi-soup.
